gameIdentification.name: ACECRAFT
gameIdentification.status: Identified by parent agent against official App Store event; no game-title logo appears in this clip

sampling.method: Existing local AVFoundation extract_video; exact time tolerance; preferred track transform applied; all 114 resulting frames visually inspected using 5 contact sheets, then representative images at original resolution.

productionUse: All frames, representative JPGs and poster are analysis references only. Do not crop them into production assets. Recreate shapes, type, icons and artwork separately; sample account/friend identities should be fictional.
familyGrouping: Animation, reward counts, toasts, collection progress banners, scrolling and repeated item bundles do not create separate UI families. Material in-screen tab layouts are named as variants.

families.name: Honk's Depot recruitment
families.layout: Full cartoon machinery scene; hanging header, 2 right event shortcuts, central wingman/capsule illustration, switch, bottom recruitment buttons, sub-tabs above global navigation.
families.entry: Video begins already inside this screen; next observed screen is Pilot List.

families.name: Pilot List
families.layout: Bronze mechanical header; filter and count; amplification progress bar; 3-column portrait card grid with level, rarity and circular equipment icons; 2 collection tabs; global navigation.
families.entry: Honk’s Depot → Pilot List → Adventure lobby.

families.name: Adventure lobby
variants: live event badges and red dots
families.layout: Player HUD and currencies at top; large hero center; 5 left/6 right floating event icons; three event shortcuts above dominant yellow Start; 5-icon global navigation at bottom.
families.entry: Pilot List → lobby; menu/mail/friends return here; Radiant Pact and Special Recruit event screens branch from here.

families.name: Lobby menu drawer
variants: Sent successfully toast while menu remains open
families.layout: Right-aligned wooden vertical drawer over dimmed lobby, approximately x233–419/y122–520.
families.entry: Lobby → menu → Mail; Mail closes to menu → Friends; Friends closes to menu → lobby.

families.name: Mail list
families.layout: Layered papers on clipboard; large all-caps title; scrollable message rows; blue Delete Read and yellow Claim All; upper-right red close badge. Approx x25–406/y188–774.
families.entry: Menu → Mail → reward overlay → menu. No individual message details are shown.

families.name: Friends list
families.layout: Tilted clipboard/paper; count, delete icon, sort control; friend rows with avatar, level, stage/status and two energy buttons; footer buttons. Approx x4–416/y144–853.
families.entry: Menu → Friends → menu. Personal account/friend names are reference content and should be replaced in a sample.

families.name: Radiant Pact recruitment
families.layout: Ice-blue full-height hero and vehicle artwork; snow/ice title; 4 event shortcuts; orb-shaped reward pool; 2 bottom recruit buttons; local back button.
families.entry: Lobby → Radiant Pact → Missions → reward overlay → lobby.

families.name: Radiant Pact missions
labels: Own Permanent Privilege during the event.
Own Monthly Pass during the event.
Claim Ad rewards 10 time(s) in total.
families.layout: Blue-framed parchment sheet; stacked mission rows with reward icon, 2-line description, progress bar and right action; sticky Claim All footer; red close badge. Approx x21–409/y188–781.
families.entry: Radiant Pact → Missions; claim reward appears over this modal; next visible full screen is lobby.

families.name: Overdrive Special Recruit
variants: ticket count changes after repeat draw
families.layout: Orange/teal canyon setting with oversized pilot and drill vehicle; event marquee; upper left reward ladder shortcut; right packs/growth shortcuts; lower history/preview; bottom recruit buttons and local back.
families.entry: Lobby → Special Recruit → reward overlay → Special Recruit → shop. Final sequence returns here from Cumulative Purchase and repeatedly draws.

families.name: Special Pack shop
variants: Chapter Pack: large horizontal illustrated chapter banners with Normal/Elite selector (38–39s)
Limited-Time: 2-column offer-card grid, long vertical scroll (40–85s)
free gift claim animation and disabled card
families.layout: Brick wall and theater lights; multi-currency top bar; centered title; 2 mode tabs. Chapter banners span almost the width. Limited offers use 2 columns with duration, value starburst, reward icon, quantity/limit, price button. Fixed 4-item shop navigation and back button.
families.entry: Special Recruit → Special Pack; scroll to offers; offer → detail → purchase confirmation → reward. Item Shop and Cumulative Purchase use bottom shop tabs.

families.name: Special Pack detail
variants: different offer item bundles and prices share one shell
families.layout: Cream paper modal with blue upper trim, title, centered horizontal reward icons, one yellow price button, close badge; underlying shop is dimmed. Approx x14–405/y326–612.
families.entry: Special Pack offer card → pack detail; choosing price → Purchase Confirmation; closing returns to shop.

families.name: Purchase Confirmation
families.layout: Large cream/blue curved frame; explanatory sentence; cash price and alternative green-ticket currency price; blue and yellow side-by-side buttons; close badge. Approx x14–405/y300–665.
families.entry: Pack detail price → confirmation → source-video purchase/reward → shop. The analysis itself performs no purchase.

families.name: Overdrive Ticket information
labels: An event item used to participate in Special Recruit. It will be converted to Skyward Recruit Tickets at a 1:1 ratio and sent to you via mail after the event ends.
families.layout: Plain large parchment card with Owned tag at upper right; centered large icon, bold item name, thin divider and centered multiline explanation. Approx x10–410/y333–635.
families.entry: Special Pack reward icon → item information → pack detail (observed next).

families.name: Item Shop
families.layout: Same brick-wall shop frame and bottom shop navigation; two sub-tabs and reset timer; 3-column square item grid with rarity backgrounds, price and purchase limit beneath.
families.entry: Special Pack → Item Shop Tempus → Medal tab; free reward is claimed; next visible screen is Cumulative Purchase.

families.name: Cumulative Purchase event
variants: Period Rewards: illustrated display stage and circular amount targets; claim footer (92–93s)
Cumulative Purchase: stacked medal milestones, progress bars and reward-icon rows; Claim/Go/completed states (96–103s)
Period Rewards after claim: next-tier requirement and Go instead of Claim (104–107s)
families.layout: Teal patterned event panel within brick shop frame. Period tab has hero display case and milestone medallions; cumulative tab has dense progress cards. Two rounded sub-tabs just above global shop navigation.
families.entry: Item Shop → Cumulative Purchase; claim → Rewards → How to Obtain; milestone tab → reward claims → Period Rewards → claim → Special Recruit.

families.name: Rewards Obtained overlay
families.layout: Shared dark purple translucent theater/stage overlay with hanging stars, soft spotlight/ellipse and centered one-or-more reward icons; underlying screen remains visible; no new independent navigation.
families.entry: Shared overlay following claims/recruit/purchases; it dismisses back to whichever family produced the reward.

families.name: How to Obtain sources
families.layout: Tall blue paper panel, cream acquisition-source rows, source icon, value ribbon, quantity and blue Go; red close badge. Approx x20–406/y211–790.
families.entry: Cumulative Purchase question/source shortcut → How to Obtain → Cumulative Purchase. Floating claimed rewards are still animating during this frame.

sharedComponents: Top currency strips with green add buttons
Five-item global navigation (Recruit/Pilot/Adventure/aircraft-like icon/reward chest icon); shop instead uses four tabs plus Back
Yellow primary and pale blue secondary bevel buttons
Cream parchment modal bodies, dark ink outlines, right red close badge
Shop currency/item flying particles after claims
Long vertical lists and horizontal mode tabs
limitations: 1-second sampling can miss sub-second transitions; entry/return descriptions follow visible screen sequences and do not prove the exact input gesture.

No gameplay/combat stage, Settings, Backpack, Account, Notice, Support details, individual mail, New Friends flow, recruitment History/Preview, alternate collection Pappo content, packs/growth detail, event battle, store Top Pick tab, or global extra tabs are shown. These are visible labels only, not observed screen families.
A small grey tooltip at the right edge of the first frame reads partial external-looking media text (5K Purple Star-Field …). It is not assigned as an ACECRAFT family.
Account and friend identity text are deliberately not transcribed into this inventory.
Full original images are preserved; poster tiles resize whole frames and add external captions without cropping.
